design.text: Wait. The market barely moved today? But smaller companies? Up almost three percent! Here's the thing. That's huge!

lines.plain: The Nifty today? Down zero point zero two percent. Basically flat!

text.directed: The Nifty today? Down zero point zero two percent. Basically flat!

lines.plain: But smaller companies? Up two point seven percent!

text.directed: But smaller companies? [surprise-oh] Up two point seven percent!

lines.plain: Quick guess: which sector jumped the most today? Answer at the end!

text.directed: Quick guess: which sector jumped the most today? Answer at the end!

lines.plain: Midcaps? Up one percent. Smallcaps? Two point seven! The smaller the company, the bigger the jump.

text.directed: Mid caps? Up one percent. Small caps? [surprise-wa] Two point seven! The smaller the company, the bigger the jump.

lines.plain: So why was the Nifty stuck? Banks! The Bank Nifty fell zero point seven percent. HDFC Bank and SBI pulled hardest.

text.directed: [question-en] So why was the Nifty stuck? Banks! The Bank Nifty fell zero point seven percent. H D F C Bank and S B I pulled hardest.

lines.plain: In rupees? One lakh in a Nifty fund: down about fifteen rupees. One lakh tracking smallcaps? Up about two thousand seven hundred!

text.directed: In rupees? One [L AA1 K] in a Nifty fund: down about fifteen rupees. One [L AA1 K] tracking small caps? Up about two thousand seven hundred!

lines.plain: Answer? C! Media stocks, up over three and a half percent.

text.directed: Answer? C! [laughter] Media stocks, up over three and a half percent.

lines.plain: So remember... a flat Nifty isn't a flat market.
